issues.issue: Unexplained Miscellaneous Revenue is 12.7% of governmental receipts (over the 10% threshold for `other`) and a third of General Fund revenue, with no budget for it (p4). It could be a one-time item such as insurance proceeds, a grant or a sale. The line is marked review, but decision_needed has no entry for it.
Inconsistent: category is general government (same as disbursements[1]) but the object is debt interest and fees. A bank charge in the Debt Service Fund fits either. Immaterial amount.

For GAAP the rule asks for 'cash and cash equivalents/investments' from the Balance Sheet Total column. The extractor left out Investments 266,356 (kept in ending_investments), so cash and investments together are 833,507. This is an assumption the user may want to confirm.
